fields.description: Issue includes local commentary and notebook-style columns about Miami’s winter season, tourism, business activity, and state politics; extensive coverage and advertising related to horse racing at Tropical Park and the opening of Hialeah Park, including handicapping/track-service promotions; nightlife and entertainment listings and bar/restaurant advertising; and notices promoting the International Wine and Liquor Exposition and a Forget-Me-Not Day drive for Disabled American Veterans.
